nodes.title: Taxila installs as an app: manifest icons are the Volt mark (rounded square at 45°, ion edge, her violet dot) on the night void #05060A, which is also the splash ground and the boot paint (no flash); public/sw.js caches the SHELL only (the shell list, Vite's hashed bundles, fonts, the icons, index.html as the offline navigation fallback) and never touches /api, generated content, audio, non-GET or cross-origin requests; it registers in production builds only; the browser's install offer is held and shown as 'Put Taxila on this phone' in Me and on Who, on a tap. Measured on a production preview: Chromium installability errors none, worker active at /, offline navigation 200 from the shell, /api offline a network error. Reverse: the owner wants a store package (TWA) instead, or the worker causes a stale-build report.

md.decisions:
## `dc-r7-app-pwa`
The owner tests on a mid-range Android phone, so Taxila should open from its own icon and look like the product from the first frame. The icon is the app's own Volt mark, and the splash, the first paint and the app share one dark ground. The worker exists only to make the app open fast and survive a dead signal: it holds the app's code and look, never a lesson, a plan, an answer or anything a child said or made. If offline, the child gets the app's own offline screen, never a stale lesson.
